says: In today's lead tooling, stepcommit.sh refuses a build-step commit that touches an exam path ('a build may not commit exam paths; answer send to tests', exit 3), and offers no step for a fix round, where decision 0177 has one agent write the law and the fix together.
proof: stepcommit.sh:112; the fix round of PR 1588 (commit f1f6e1374, which changes .github/ci/shard-times.test.ts and vitest.shards.ts) was refused and committed with a plain git commit.
cost: Every fix round that touches a law bypasses the commit script, so its owner checks do not run on that commit.
